title: Code Snippets
content: Create code snippet display component with syntax highlighting. Container: bg-gray-900 rounded-lg overflow-hidden. Header bar: flex justify-between with language label (text-gray-400 text-sm) and copy button. Copy button: Copy icon, onClick copies code to clipboard, shows "Copied!" feedback for 2 seconds. Code area: p-4 overflow-x-auto, font-mono text-sm. Line numbers optional: text-gray-500 pr-4 select-none. Syntax highlighting: use basic CSS classes for keywords (text-blue-400), strings (text-green-400), comments (text-gray-500), functions (text-yellow-400). Or integrate Prism.js/highlight.js for full highlighting. Support language prop: javascript, typescript, python, bash, json, html, css. Add horizontal scroll for long lines. Dark theme by default, optional light theme variant.

variants.advanced: Create code snippet display component with syntax highlighting and copy functionality. Container: bg-gray-900 rounded-lg overflow-hidden, or bg-gray-100 for light theme. Header bar: flex items-center justify-between px-4 py-2 bg-gray-800/50 border-b border-gray-700, language label (text-gray-400 text-xs uppercase tracking-wide), filename if provided, copy button. Copy button: flex items-center gap-1, Copy icon (h-4 w-4), text "Copy", onClick uses navigator.clipboard.writeText(code), shows "Copied!" with Check icon for 2 seconds, then reverts. Code area: p-4 overflow-x-auto, font-mono text-sm leading-relaxed, whitespace-pre for preserving formatting. Line numbers: optional, table layout with line numbers in left column (text-gray-500 pr-4 text-right select-none user-select-none), code in right column; or CSS counter approach. Syntax highlighting options: 1) Basic CSS classes (text-blue-400 keywords, text-green-400 strings, text-purple-400 numbers, text-gray-500 comments, text-yellow-400 functions), 2) Prism.js integration (lightweight, many languages), 3) highlight.js (more languages, larger), 4) Shiki (VS Code-accurate, SSR-friendly). Language support: javascript, typescript, jsx, tsx, python, bash, shell, json, html, css, sql, rust, go, etc. Component props: code (string), language, showLineNumbers?, filename?, className. Light/dark themes: provide both, or respect system preference. Scrolling: horizontal scroll for long lines, vertical scroll for many lines with max-height. Diff view variant: show added (bg-green-900/30) and removed (bg-red-900/30) lines. Accessibility: code block should be keyboard navigable if interactive, consider aria-label describing content.
